text:
TWO PLACES FOR THE REPAIR WORKSHOP

Station hall is the provisional recommendation

The committee provisionally recommends Station hall for its capacity and bus access; booking is not approved.

Station hall
PROVISIONAL RECOMMENDATION
Capacity
48 people
Hire
€240 per evening
Access
Step-free entrance, next to the bus station
Constraint
Tools and tables must be removed each evening
Garden room
ALTERNATIVE
Capacity
32 people
Hire
€160 per evening
Access
Step-free entrance, 700 m from the bus station
Constraint
Tools can stay in a locked cupboard

All costs are provisional quotes for one evening; staffing and insurance are excluded.
